masters.name: Valora
masters.note: The greatest her tribe that grants a perk to [Bear Hunt].
masters.story: Valora 's homeland seems at first glance to be a green paradise, full of rolling mountains and forests. It is anything but. Life there is harsh because these woods are also home to some of the most dangerous beasts ever known. Even a skilled tribe of hunters like Valora 's are in a constant struggle of survival against a land that wants to eat them alive. The tribal council is always watching for hunters whose fortunes might lift their own. That day came with Valora 's rite-of-passage. Tribal tradition requires those coming of age to take part in the Forest Rite, a deadly game of cat and mouse against one of its greatest beasts. That night Valora returned full of bruises but carrying one of the greatest prizes of all: a giant boar head. There was a moment of awe followed by cheers and a ce...

talent.name: Hunter Instinct
talent.description: Valora was born with the instincts of a true warrior and so inflicts 2–30% additional Bear Hunt Damage Points (effective for self only).

skills.name: Dance of the Hunt
skills.description: Valora dances the ways of the ancestors to great effect, beseeching their blessing upon the feast and increasing Raging Bear Rally Squad Capacity by 30000–300000 .

skills.name: Leader By Example
skills.description: "A leader who leads by example travels farther." Valora's inspirational guidance provides 1–5 extra 100 Enhancement XP Part rewards per Bear Hunt.

skills.name: Weapon Obsession
skills.description: "A hunter must know their weapons like the back of their hand." Valora's constant focus on gear provides 1–5 additional Forgehammer rewards per Bear Hunt.

skills.name: Savage Advantage
skills.description: Valora's wild instincts embolden her soldiers, increasing Bear Hunt Squad Capacity by 3000–30000 .

masters.name: Pan
masters.note: A crafty palace administrator that grants perks to [Town Development].
masters.story: Pan 's life story reads like an abridged version of the empire 's own recent history. Pan learned from a young age exactly what matters in a royal court as a palace attendant. His careful and often wise judgments earned him a place of respect that might have endured til this day. Sadly, his rare title of "Royal Advisor " was not meant to last. Pan and his king experienced disaster after disaster, starting with the Cesares Rebellion and ending in the fall of the royal house and splintering of the empire into fiefdoms. Only Pan 's great reputation helped him land an appointment to run the border town of Noba. But not even Pan could save Noba from itself. While Noba 's peasants roamed in search of food, its nobles ate away at its wealth until there was nothing left but them and the have-nots....

talent.name: Efficient Reserves
talent.description: As a crafty veteran gatherer, Pan handles such tasks more efficiently, gaining 1–5 Reserve Chests every 120 total gathering mins. Daily limit: 10–30 . Refreshes at UTC 00:00.

skills.name: Falconer
skills.description: Pan's skilled falconry gives them greater range, increasing the number of daily Watchtower Intel Missions found by 2–8 .

skills.name: Good Steward
skills.description: A good steward must be responsible for their master's needs. Pan increases the Storehouse's Governor Stamina replenishment by 10–40 .

skills.name: Master Architect
skills.description: Pan is a master of construction efficiency, speeding up construction by 2–8 hours on every new build.

skills.name: Ways and Means
skills.description: An experienced manager sees opportunities others don't. Pan gains 20–120 additional Mystery Badge(s) upon daily mission completion and 1–4 more free refreshes at the Mystery Shop.

masters.name: Roman
masters.note: A star of the arena who can help you in every [Arena] match.
masters.story: Eighteen-year-old Roman entered the arena with all the force of a hurricane. The spotlight loved the new challenger with his sinews of iron, fists of steel, and lion 's roar. He quickly became the crowd favorite and no swordsman, conniving bandit, or combat-hungry general seemed to get in his way. But it was not to last. Roman entered the championship final at what was supposed to be the top of his game, the actual battle just a stepping stone to the trophy. The crowd went wild but then slowly fell silent as it became obvious Roman was about to be soundly defeated. Nothing in Roman 's instincts or training seemed to help him that day. Cheers turned to insults as he left the field, humiliated. Roman was supposed to be a winner. He could not accept the reality that, yes indeed, he could fail...

talent.name: Star Belligerent
talent.description: Roman is such a beloved arena star that his fans are always showering him with gifts, granting a 50–100% chance of getting 1–3 extra Arena Star Chest(s) after each match.

skills.name: Teacher of Champions
skills.description: Roman trains candidates in skills that will not soon be forgot, increasing Escorts' Arena Battle Attack and Health by 2–20% .

skills.name: Winner Take All
skills.description: "There can be only one!" Roman often declares. True to form, he increases the Daily and Weekly Arena Token rewards by 5–50% .

skills.name: Crowd Favorite
skills.description: The perks of Roman's popularity aren't limited to stylish outfits and catchphrases, but also 1–3 extra Arena Shop items discounted by 5–50% .

skills.name: One Desire
skills.description: To receive honor and glory upon the same podium on which Roman stands is the dream of every hero in the Arena, boosting Arena Battle Attack and Health by 2–20% .

masters.name: Cassia
masters.note: A famed queen commander of the battlefield grants perks in [Battles].
masters.story: Not many of the king 's royal strategists could claim Cassia 's unbroken string of victories. A master of deployment in force, Cassia turned large military formations into a science. As the king 's greatest commander, the equation was simple given Cassia would have access to a force at least as large as her opponent 's. No guerrilla warfare or psychological tactics were necessary. Even enemies of the king were said to have surrendered as soon as they heard a rumor that Cassia was on her way. Cassia 's rising star was not embraced by everyone. As her influence shined brighter, other powerful nobles in the court seemed to fade. The spark of envy grew into a flame of jealousy until Cassia suffered her first crushing defeat. Her soldiers were slaughtered by an enemy that seemed to know her eve...

talent.name: Horn of Valor
talent.description: Cassia sounds her horn with enough valor to inspire a vast army, increasing Squad size limit by 300–10000 .

skills.name: Recruiter In Chief
skills.description: Cassia has found new ways to boost recruitment beyond the barracks, allowing free recruitment of 150–600 additional high-level soldiers from any Camp, as well as an additional 1–10 Soldier's Medallion(s) from the Enlistment Office.

skills.name: Firepower to Win
skills.description: Cassia's lifetime of battlefield experience equates to 0.5–10% increased Squad Attack and Defense.

skills.name: Commando
skills.description: Cassia's habit of handpicking elite squads increases Squad Lethality and Health by 0.5–10% .

skills.name: Inspiring Mobilization
skills.description: Cassia's inspiring visions of a post-Truegold society have helped her boost Rally Squad Capacity by 5000–100000 .

masters.name: Wilson
masters.note: A messenger who relays alliance news at a moment 's notice. He provides valuable bonuses during Alliance Events.
masters.story: Wilson was once a royal messenger serving the royal court. Whenever any decree was issued, he would be sent out to deliver it to the people. Good news, bad news, judgments... Countless messages passed through his lips. He had seen crowds of citizens gathering in cheers, old women who fainted from grief, and criminals so terrified they dropped to their knees begging for mercy on the spot. But no matter the situation, Wilson could only ever keep his expression stiff and stern, or rather, he had no choice but to. He had to preserve the dignity of the royal family at all times. The chaos before him felt like it belonged to another world entirely. Over time, Wilson grew weary of that life. He chose to leave the court and become a messenger for an Alliance, where he no longer had to be an unfeel...

talent.name: Trade Decree
talent.description: Wilson always delivers the latest trade regulations on time, reducing prices in the Alliance Shop by 5–15% ; additionally increases Personal Activity Triumph Chest rewards by 20–100% .

skills.name: Mobilization Master
skills.description: Wilson's encouragement fuels the drive of all allies. Increases Alliance Mobilization points by 2–20% , and Milestones gain 1–3 extra tier(s) .

skills.name: Championship Publicity
skills.description: Wilson has spread the word of the Alliance Championship across the continent, attracting a swarm of sponsors. Increases Championship Badges earned during the event by 5–50% , and the Championship Shop gains 1–3 extra item(s) .

skills.name: Viking Bounty
skills.description: Wilson spread word of the Viking bounties to every household in town, increasing points earned during the Viking Vengeance event by 5–50% . For every 200,000 points earned, you gain one chest reward , up to 1–10 per event.

skills.name: Duel Sponsorship
skills.description: Wilson brings excellent news regarding alliance sponsps. Increases points earned by Governors in the Alliance Brawl by 5–50% (excluding the Merchant Empire event), and daily progress rewards gain 1–3 extra tier(s) .

masters.name: Guinevere
masters.note: A mysterious woman intricately tied to the Holy Sword. She provides significant buffs during Swordland Showdown and Swordland Summit League.
masters.story: When Guinevere opens her eyes, she is met with a completely unfamiliar scene. Most of her memories are gone, and she can only recall fragments of even her own name. But as if drawn by some unseen force, she follows it forward and arrives at a place that looks like a battlefield. Countless people are fighting desperately here, all with their sights set on the Holy Sword in the distance. Guinevere soon realizes that what is drawing her in is the Holy Sword standing at the very center of the battlefield. For reasons she can not explain, every time she looks at it, an overwhelming tide of emotions rises within her: nostalgia, admiration, guilt, pain, yearning... It is almost as if a voice is telling her that living without memories wouldn 't be so bad. But she refuses to take the easy way out....

talent.name: Holy Sword Domain
talent.description: When near the Holy Sword, Guinevere channels immense power, granting Squads +2–30% Attack and +2–30% Defense during the Swordland Showdown and Swordland Summit League.

skills.name: Max Efficiency
skills.description: Guinevere always makes the right choice. Relic Coins gains are increased by 10–100% .

skills.name: Merciful Heart
skills.description: Guinevere cannot turn a blind eye to the wounded. She instantly heals 100000–1000000 soldiers for free in every Swordland Showdown and Swordland Summit League.

skills.name: Royal Guidance
skills.description: Guinevere issues precise combat orders, granting Squads participating in Swordland Showdown and Swordland Summit League +1.5–30% Lethality and +1.5–30% Health.

skills.name: Call of Round Table
skills.description: Guinevere is determined to secure Holy Sword and rallies more Squads to her cause. Increases Rally Capacity by 7500–150000 during Swordland Showdown and Swordland Summit League.
